purpose: Durable teachings for loss-pattern learning. These teachings explain how Atlas should learn from losses without banning a setup family or silently changing strategy, risk, or execution policy.

teachings.title: False Continuation Requires Confirmation
teachings.lesson: A continuation idea is not executable just because direction exists. Atlas must require structure to hold, strong or turning M1 momentum, and same-side support before trusting continuation again.
failed_when: continuation was assumed before structure held
teachings.teaching_action: Trade the continuation pattern again only when the failed confirmation ingredient has changed.

teachings.title: Timing Failure Needs Fresher Entry
teachings.lesson: When the idea was possibly valid but timing was early, late, or weak, Atlas should not discard the idea. It should wait for a fresher entry, retest, pullback, or cleaner trigger.
teachings.teaching_action: Separate idea quality from entry timing quality before applying a lesson.

teachings.title: Momentum Must Confirm
teachings.lesson: Mixed M1 momentum is not enough for a continuation setup after recent losses. Atlas should wait for strong or clearly turning momentum before treating the setup as corrected.
teachings.teaching_action: Do not repeat weak-momentum entries; wait until momentum confirms the same side.

teachings.title: Structure Must Hold
teachings.lesson: Structure labels like HH/HL or LH/LL are not enough by themselves. Atlas needs evidence that structure is holding at the entry location before execution review.
failed_when: price was mid-range without a clean reaction
teachings.teaching_action: Treat unclear structure as developing context, not execution permission.

teachings.title: Loss Pattern Is Not Pattern Ban
teachings.lesson: A loss in a pattern does not mean Atlas must stop trading that pattern. It means Atlas must identify what failed and require a corrected version before trading it again.
failed_when: same pattern is repeated with the same missing evidence
loss memory is interpreted as a blanket ban
confidence is punished without a correction path
teachings.teaching_action: Keep the pattern tradable, but require proof that the previous mistake is not being repeated.

teachings.title: Safety Lock Is Separate From Learning
teachings.lesson: The safety lock protects the account after weak performance. It is not a lesson that a setup family should never trade again.
failed_when: risk protection is confused with pattern learning
operator assumes safety lock means strategy ban
Atlas explains safety as if it were setup logic
teachings.teaching_action: Explain safety lock and pattern learning as separate lanes.

policy_note: These teachings are bounded knowledge and observability. They do not rewrite strategies, lower thresholds, alter risk, unlock safety, force entries, or bypass execution gates.
